notes: Seven fixed startup checks in a read-only, reconstructed pinned tools root. Distinct namespaces, loopback only, isolated temporary storage. Host launcher/kernel unpinned. No package installation, maintainer hooks, image build, boot or attestation. Pinned unshare adds a child PID namespace and its own procfs; no host process view. Existing host subordinate-ID helpers allocate the user namespace; private tmpfs ownership is checked. Host helper hashes are observations, not pinned build inputs. Pinned setpriv restricts capabilities; pinned libseccomp prevents namespace/mount reconfiguration. Negative syscall probes, descriptor and readonly-root checks precede tool startups. No aggregate build resource qualification.
